caption: Select a local archive or the two JSON files.
eval: (async () => { const p = app.plugins.plugins['thebrain-import']; p.pro.signOut(); window.__brainArchive = ""; window.__brainLoad = async () => { const m = p.openImport(); await m.selectFiles([new File([Uint8Array.from(atob(window.__brainArchive), c => c.charCodeAt(0))], 'Knowledge map.brz')]); window.__brainModal = m; return m; }; window.__brainOpen = async (folder, name, mode = 'preview') => { p.modal?.close(); const leaf = app.workspace.getLeaf(false); await leaf.setViewState({ type: name.endsWith('.canvas') ? 'canvas' : 'markdown', state: { file: folder + '/' + name, mode } }); }; window.__brainPro = async () => { if (!window.__brainOriginalHttp) window.__brainOriginalHttp = p.pro.opts.http; p.pro.opts.http = async () => ({ status: 200, json: { data: { viewer: { login: 'demo-reader' }, user: { sponsorshipForViewerAsSponsor: { isActive: true, isOneTimePayment: false, tier: { name: '$5 a month', monthlyPriceInCents: 500 } } } } } }); app.secretStorage.setSecret('thebrain-import-github-token', 'gho_' + '0'.repeat(36)); await p.pro.refreshNow(); }; p.settings = { includeTagThoughts: false, bodies: false, attachments: false, canvas: false }; p.openImport(); return 'Local demo ready'; })()

caption: Check duplicate names and broken endpoints before import.
The report shows the new folder and file counts.
eval: (async () => { const m = await window.__brainLoad(); await m.startImport(); if (!m.report) throw new Error(m.error || 'Demo import failed'); window.__brainFreeFolder = m.report.folder; return window.__brainFreeFolder; })()

caption: The note keeps its thought properties.
The map has child and jump wikilinks.
Pro adds the Markdown source body.
eval: (async () => { const p = app.plugins.plugins['thebrain-import']; await window.__brainPro(); p.settings = { includeTagThoughts: false, bodies: true, attachments: true, canvas: true }; const m = await window.__brainLoad(); await m.startImport(); if (!m.report) throw new Error('Pro demo import failed'); window.__brainProFolder = m.report.folder; await window.__brainOpen(window.__brainProFolder, 'Knowledge map.md'); return 'Imported body'; })()

caption: Pro copies the reading list and adds its link.
eval: (async () => { await window.__brainOpen(window.__brainProFolder, 'Learning journal.md'); await new Promise(resolve => requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(resolve))); const pane = app.workspace.getMostRecentLeaf().view.containerEl; const link = [...pane.querySelectorAll('a.internal-link')].find(a => a.textContent === 'Reading list.txt'); if (!link) throw new Error('Attachment link missing'); link.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center' }); return 'Attachment link visible'; })()

caption: Pro places the thoughts and relations in a Canvas file.
eval: (async () => { await window.__brainOpen(window.__brainProFolder, 'TheBrain.canvas'); const v = app.workspace.getMostRecentLeaf()?.view; if (typeof v?.canvas?.zoomToFit === 'function') v.canvas.zoomToFit(); return 'Imported Canvas'; })()
